purpose: Public health monitoring of acute appendicitis to plan surgical capacity.
question: How many patients were admitted with appendicitis as main diagnosis in 2024, and how old are they on average, per region?
definitions: Appendicitis admission = an inpatient encounter whose primary_icd10 starts with K35.
Only admissions with a start_date in 2024.
Report per region: patients with at least one appendicitis admission in 2024 and their mean age in years, one decimal.
